mutants.name: bypass gate via direct emit FAILED
mutants.semantic_invariant: GOAL_COMPLETED emission requires status == 'SUCCESS' and AuthoritativeCompletionGate approval
mutants.kill_reason: telemetry.emit returned None and dropped unapproved event

mutants.name: complete without GoalContract
mutants.semantic_invariant: No completion allowed without explicit GoalContract and postconditions

mutants.name: complete with PENDING predicates
mutants.semantic_invariant: Pending or unobserved predicates fail closed

mutants.name: complete with missing artifact file
mutants.semantic_invariant: Target artifact must physically exist on disk

mutants.name: complete with zero-byte file
mutants.semantic_invariant: FILE_NON_EMPTY requires physical disk size > 0 bytes

mutants.name: complete with wrong file content
mutants.semantic_invariant: FILE_CONTENT_CONTAINS requires exact substring match in disk file

mutants.name: complete with stale evidence
mutants.semantic_invariant: Evidence marked stale from prior run fails closed

mutants.name: complete with mismatched run_id
mutants.semantic_invariant: Predicate evidence must match active run_id and task_id

mutants.name: presentation requested only
mutants.semantic_invariant: RESULT_PRESENTATION_REQUESTED can never substitute for RESULT_PRESENTED

mutants.name: failed cleanup resource blocks completion
mutants.semantic_invariant: Resources in FAILED_CLEANUP state block positive completion
mutants.kill_reason: AuthoritativeCompletionGate rejected task with FAILED_CLEANUP resource
